patch_description: Instead of a pure one-pass greedy, start with the greedy assignment (sorted by req_rate/slo descending, place on GPU minimizing resulting KVPR), then run an iterative local search: repeatedly find the GPU with maximum KVPR and try moving one of its models to another GPU (or swapping with a model on another GPU) if it reduces the overall max KVPR, subject to memory constraints. This refinement escapes the greedy's myopic choices and directly minimizes the objective.
